title: cylinder
body:
## cylinder

Creates a polygonal cylinder surface of given radius and height, centred on centre with its axis parallel to y, including point normals and texture coordinates. resolution sets the facets around the axis and capping closes both ends. There is no orientation setting: follow it with transform to rotate the cylinder.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The axis is always along y before any transform; a cylinder meant along z needs a 90-degree rotation about x.

Native constructor: `Cylinder`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `centre` | This property specifies the coordinate value at the center of the cylinder. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `height` | This property specifies the height of the cylinder (along the y axis). | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true}` | `2` | `2` |
| `radius` | This property specifies the radius of the cylinder. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true}` | `1` | `1` |
| `resolution` | This property indicates the number of divisions around the cylinder. The higher this number, the closer the polygonal approximation will come to representing a cylinder, and the more polygons it will contain. Schemaxis accepts at most 512 facets: the bundled VTK clamps larger values to 512 (VTK_CELL_SIZE) without a warning, so a larger request would not be honoured. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":3,"maximum":512}` | `32` | `32` |
| `capping` | If this property is set to 1, the ends of the cylinder will each be capped with a closed polygon. Otherwise, the ends of the cylinder will be open. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "cylinder"
}
```
